title: Filtered derived Hom continuity for a locally closed piece
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite intermediate field $E$ of $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$
[def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set], and a scheme $T$. Use the coefficient sheaves,
internal module categories $\mathcal M_T^c(E)$ and their ordinary derived categories of
[def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. A module is locally finitely presented if it
admits a pro-etale covering on which it is a cokernel of a map between finite free modules.
A module is constructible if it has a finite locally closed stratification with constructible
underlying strata on each of which its inverse image is locally finitely presented.

Suppose $T$ has noetherian underlying space, $I$ is a small filtered category and
$N:I\to C(\mathcal M_T^c(E))$ is a diagram of cochain complexes with a common termwise
lower bound: there is $a\in\mathbf Z$ such that $N_i^r=0$ for every $i$ and $r<a$.
Let $Q$ be localization to the ordinary derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and apply $Q$ to the canonical termwise colimit cocone of $N$.
Every piece $K$ [def-weil-pbc-condensed-constructible-piece] satisfies the Hom continuity
property [def-weil-pbc-hom-colimit-property] for this cocone: for every integer $n$, the
canonical map $\varinjlim_i\operatorname{Hom}(K,QN_i[n])\to
\operatorname{Hom}(K,Q(\varinjlim_iN_i)[n])$ is an isomorphism of abelian groups.

proof.text: Write the piece as $i_*j_!P[0]$ up to isomorphism. The closed source and its open subscheme are noetherian and qcqs. Local finite presentation over the finite field coefficients gives a pro-etale local finite free presentation of $P$.

proof.text: For a uniformly bounded-below diagram $L$ on that open, the derived Hom formula identifies Hom(P[0],L[n]) with degree-n derived sections of $P^\vee\otimes L$. The finite locally free dual tensor functor is exact, preserves the bound and filtered colimits. Apply qcqs derived global sections continuity. Transport between internal module objects and the ringed-site module presentation with the same coefficient sheaf; retain the evaluation normalization, so these are the canonical maps on Hom groups, not arbitrary group isomorphisms.

proof.text: The closed adjunction and open extension-by-zero adjunction identify ambient Hom groups with Hom(P[0],j^*Ri^!N[n]). Recollement identifies $i_*Ri^!N$ with Cone(N\to Rk_*k^*N)[-1], where $k$ is the complementary quasi-compact open. Qcqs pushforward continuity and exact filtered colimits give continuity of that cone and hence of $Ri^!$, using fully faithful exact closed pushforward. The costalk and exact open restriction preserve a common lower bound. Use functorial bounded injective representatives and good truncation to express these derived diagrams in the strict uniformly bounded-below form required in the previous step.
